title: Prove runner with a no-money operator quickstart
trusted_prompt: Add docs/runner-demo.md as a concise operator quickstart for the runner that is already implemented on this base branch. Derive command syntax from scripts/agent_runner.py --help. Cover status, pause, resume, and stop using placeholders rather than invented IDs. State that pause and stop are cooperative at an active model-turn boundary, resume reuses durable state, and current safety defaults remain mock/disabled/false. Do not claim auto-merge, deployment, an Antigravity model run, or any capability that this task did not exercise.
acceptance_criteria: The four control commands are accurate and use placeholders rather than invented run or session IDs.
The document states pause and stop are cooperative at an active model-turn boundary and resume reuses durable state.
The document preserves SUPPLIER_MODE=mock, PAYMENT_MODE=disabled, and ALLOW_REAL_PURCHASES=false.
The document does not claim auto-merge, deployment, or an Antigravity generation occurred.
